evidence.reason: `_timer_schedule_seconds` computes the completion bound from `OnCalendar`, `OnUnitActiveSec`, `OnUnitInactiveSec`, and `AccuracySec` only. A timer declaring `RandomizedDelaySec=` is therefore admitted with an understated bound, because systemd can delay activation by up to that value. This is an ordinary implementation defect in the existing bound calculation; the smallest compatible fix is to include the directive in the delay term or reject timers that declare it.
